headline: Specter of rate hike? Kotecki, MPC: the balance of risks is clearly negative
summary: MPC member Ludwik Kotecki said a 25 basis point rate hike will be necessary in November if the inflation projection does not show CPI near 2.5% by end-2027 or early 2028. He said the balance of risks is clearly negative.
why: The Monetary Policy Council sets Poland's benchmark interest rates, which influence the zloty, government bond yields and borrowing costs.
why_moved: A policy member said the balance of risks is clearly negative and that a November hike may be needed if inflation projections do not fall back toward target.
